news.title: Amazon Seeks FCC Approval to Launch Over 5,000 Satellites - Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN)
news.summary: Amazon is seeking FCC approval to launch over 5,000 low Earth orbit satellites for its new "Leo Direct-to-Device" service, aiming for deployment by 2028. This move intensifies competition with Elon Musk's Starlink, particularly in providing satellite connectivity directly to smartphones. The initiative leverages Amazon's prior merger agreement with Globalstar, utilizing its spectrum to enable D2D capabilities.

news.title: AI Is Replacing Customer Service Jobs at CBA, Microsoft, Uber
news.summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being deployed by major companies like Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Microsoft, and Uber to automate customer service functions, leading to significant job losses. This trend, driven by AI advancements and the pressure on executives to adopt new technologies, is projected to impact nearly half of all customer service roles globally by 2030, with a particularly harsh effect on outsourced operations in countries like the Philippines and India. While some companies claim AI helps workers be more productive, salespeople openly pitch it as a cost-cutting measure to reduce labor expenses.
